line: Give someone the benefit of the doubt today.
paragraph: Xie Junwu spent years climbing mountains and finishing marathons in his wheelchair. Now he skateboards and teaches others how to do the same. He runs what is almost certainly China's first wheelchair skateboarding classes. His students come unsure of their own steering and braking. They leave with sore arms and steadier hands. Xie does not promise them records. He lets them feel the board tilt and roll beneath them until doubt loosens its grip.
